newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 12.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Sept 12.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Market heavyweight's shares under pressure due to weakening metals prices, broker profit downgrades and downbeat comments by managing director John Prescott.

Moody's Investors Service said overnight it had raised the debt ratings of Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd (senior to Aa3 from A1). Moody's also raised the bank financial strength rating of ANZ to B from C+. The ratings were placed on review for possible upgrade on June 25.

UK hotels group Thistle Hotels Plc said on Wednesday the offer price in its flotation is expected to be between 170 and 210 pence per share. The price values Thistle, Britain's second largest hotel group, at betweeen 1.05 billion and 1.24 billion stg. The offer will leave New Zealand's Brierley Investments Ltd, which currently holds 70 percent of the company, with less than 50 percent.

Buenaventura SA said Wednesday it had won a lawsuit allowing the company and its partner, Newmont Mining Co, to exercise pre-emptive rights to buy a 24.7 percent stake in Peru's largest gold miner Minera Yanacocha S.A, preventing the transfer of the stake to Australia's Normandy Poseidon Ltd.
Hudson Conway posted a steady net profit for the year to June 30 of A$25.72 million, steady on the previous year.
Ipoh Ltd said on Wednesday it expected calendar 1996 net profit to fall to A$8.7 million but the total dividend to rise by 25 percent.
Greyhound said late on Wednesday its net loss for the year to June 30 widened to A$7.69 million.

Resolute Samantha Ltd said late on Wednesday that it expected steady earnings and gold production in the year to June 30, 1997 compared with 1995/96. "I think next year, at this stage, it looks like being the same as this year, because all four gold mines are working," Resolute's director of exploration, Ross Kennedy, told reporters in answer to a question about earnings and production.
